title: How Stanford Teaches AI-Native Engineering — Mihail Eric, Monaco
author: swyx .ai
description: What happens when students can one-shot last year’s homework? Inside CS146S and the engineering team at Monaco.
summary: The AI Engineer YouTube channel just crossed one million subscribers . Thank you to everyone who’s watched a talk, sent one to a teammate, or put something they learned into production.
takeaways: Build a coding agent and look inside Claude Code — Mihail’s walkthroughs of the tool loop and the harness around it.
He teaches The Modern Software Developer at Stanford and leads AI at Monaco, where his colleagues use coding agents to ship software and investigate outages.
In one exercise, students ran an AI code reviewer on a repo and evaluated its feedback.
